global.note_max_bytes: Default per-file size ceiling: 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) — files larger are skipped and flagged 'not scanned: exceeds size limit' rather than silently truncated or (worse) silently judged on a partial read. Generated/vendored data files (e.g. lockfiles, minified bundles, SQL dumps) are the common offenders and are already caught by name-based excludes above; the byte-size gate exists to catch what name-matching misses.
global.note_symlinks: Symlinks are not followed by default (both for directory traversal and for individual file reads) to avoid double-counting content reachable by two paths and to avoid escaping the repository root (symlink pointing outside the scanned tree). A scanner MAY offer an explicit --follow-symlinks opt-in; even then it should track visited inodes/realpaths to break cycles.
